title: HackShastra Build Night
description: A one-night sprint for curious minds. We paired first-time builders with experienced mentors and shipped small, useful things by midnight.

title: The Open Source Social
description: A friendly online gathering to find a first issue, meet maintainers, and make open source feel open to everyone.

title: HI-O
description: HackShastra IPEC Orientation is designed to introduce students to the HackShastra community, where technology meets creativity.

title: SnowHackIPEC
description: IPEC's annual winter hackathon organized by HackShastra.

title: TEXPO'26
description: TEXPO 2026 brings together students, faculty, startups, and technology companies on a single platform, creating opportunities for exposure, validation, collaboration, and talent discovery.

title: ShubhShastra
description: ShubhShastra is a 24-hour National Level AI Hackathon being organized through a collaboration between HackShastra and Subharti University, Meerut.

title: Grand Hack IPEC
description: Grand Hack IPEC is a 24-hour national-level offline hackathon organized by HackShastra in collaboration with Inderprastha Engineering College (IPEC), Ghaziabad.
